messages:
dmitri: Heads up — I'm prepping the staging -> prod namespace swap for payment-service. Question: are we comfortable with the current serviceAccount -> IAM mapping? I want to avoid a downstream rollout failure during promote. pinging @carla for IAM context
carla: Thanks. The mapping changed in the TF plan: we moved from a static binding to an identity-mapped role to support multi-tenant SA names. TL;DR: promote only if you include the new `identity_mapping` block.
alice: can you paste the small tf snippet here? easier to eyeball.
dmitri: sure — stripped down snippet below. This is what's currently in staging overlay.tf
```hcl
resource "google_service_account_iam_binding" "payment_runner" {
  service_account_id = "projects/myproj/serviceAccounts/${var.sa_name}"
  role               = "roles/run.invoker"
  members            = ["serviceAccount:${var.identity_mapping}"]
}

# identity_mapping is set by overlay config:
# identity_mapping = "projects/-/serviceAccounts/payment-runner@customers.example.com"
```
ben: quick Q — when we promote, will `var.identity_mapping` be updated by the prod overlay automatically or do we need a manual tfvar?
carla: prod overlay has a template that substitutes customer-specific SA. But the promote pipeline currently only copies overlays; it doesn't regenerate templates. So you'll need to set the tfvar or include the concrete mapping in the prod overlay PR.
dmitri: ok — plan: open a small PR to prod overlay to add the mapping, include a short runbook note. Wdyt about gating the promote until we have a successful `terraform plan` in the staging->prod test account?
alice: yes gate it. Add an automatic `tf plan` check in the promote workflow. infra-bot can post status.
infra-bot: deploy-checker triggered: create a branch `promote/payment-svc-namespace-swap`, run `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars` in sandbox-prod (ETA ~4m).
dmitri: created PR and kicked the plan. Link: https://git.example.com/redwood/overlays-prod/-/merge_requests/1234
ben: seeing an error in the plan: "serviceAccount project lookup failed" — seems the prod account doesn't have the SA yet. Might need to create the SA in prod first or change the binding to use `for_each` conditional on existence.
carla: agree. Two safe options:
- create placeholder SA with limited perms before promote, or
- wrap the iam_binding in a `count = var.sa_exists ? 1 : 0` guard and have a separate job that ensures `var.sa_exists=true` only after SA creation.
alice: leaning to the guarded binding. less blast radius. Also update the rollout notes to include a manual SA creation step for legacy customers.
dmitri: going to add `count` guard and update the prod overlay with the concrete mapping + count toggle. Will re-run plan and post results. Thanks for the quick triage.
carla: one more: update the console dashboard to show failed SA bindings on rollout so SRE can catch post-promote issues. I'll file a tiny follow-up ticket.
dmitri: noted. I'll hold the promote until infra-bot reports green.
infra-bot: terraform plan finished: 0 failures in sandbox-prod (with counted guard). Ready for promote when lead approves. :white_check_mark:
